ONDM.name: On Demand
ONDM.definition: Exchange is performed if requested by the acquirer in a previous exchange, or at any time by the acceptor.

IMMD.name: Immediately
IMMD.definition: Exchange is performed just after the transaction completion.

ASAP.name: As Soon As Possible
ASAP.definition: As soon as the acquirer is contacted, for example with the next on-line transaction.

AGRP.name: As Group
AGRP.definition: Exchanges are performed after reaching a maximum number of transaction or time period.

NBLT.name: Number Limit
NBLT.definition: Exchange is performed after reaching a number of transactions without exchanges with the acquirer.

TTLT.name: Total Limit
TTLT.definition: Exchange is performed after reaching a cumulative amount of transactions without exchanges with the acquirer.

CYCL.name: Cyclic
CYCL.definition: Cyclic exchanges based on the related time conditions.

BLCK.name: Blocking
BLCK.definition: All pending process must be paused until exchange is exclusively performed just after the transaction completion.
